note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3473 VARIABLE LABELS and 3473.sav variable labels (identical) P5 'Grado de acuerdo con que solo se puede ser feliz si también lo son las personas que rodean a la persona entrevistada', P7_1 'Lo más importante en la vida es ser feliz', P7_2 'Siempre hay que respetar las opiniones de los/as demás, aunque sean diferentes a las propias', P7_3 'Todas las personas tienen el derecho a elegir libremente qué quieren ser y cómo quieren vivir', P7_4 'Lo que más desean las personas es autorrealizarse y hacer cosas que tengan sentido para ellas'; VALUE LABELS for all five 1 'Muy de acuerdo' 2 'De acuerdo' 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' 4 'En desacuerdo' 5 'Muy en desacuerdo' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.'. Derivation: data/spain_2024_values.do imports 3473_num.csv with case(lower) and sets item = the source variable name, so the codes ARE the CIS names (P5 -> p5, P7_1..P7_4 -> p7_1..p7_4); no positional step. Re-running the .do logic on 3473_num.csv (id = row number, drop 3/8/9) reproduces the live table exactly: 14046 rows, id-item-resp row sets identical (0/0 set differences), item x resp counts at 1/2/4/5 p5 943/1419/382/51, p7_1 1151/1346/279/23, p7_2 1689/921/173/44, p7_3 1834/880/89/22, p7_4 1118/1459/198/25 (compared against the locally cached irw_fetch copy made by table_context.R; no new export). text_source=study_materials: wording transcribed verbatim from cues3473.pdf (pdftotext, both -layout and raw renderings). P.5 is a standalone question, so its whole read-aloud text (lead-in, quoted statement, agreement question) is p5's item_text with no section_prompt, section_id _1. P.7's shared read-aloud question is section_prompt for the four P7 statements (section_id _2); the interviewer direction '(ENTREVISTADOR/A: LEER UNA A UNA Y ANOTAR. LAS AFIRMACIONES ROTAN)' is not addressed to the respondent and is not shipped -- the four statements were administered in rotated order. instructions blank because the framing differs between P.5 and P.7. P7_2: questionnaire reads 'de los demás' while the syntax/.sav label reads 'de los/as demás'; the questionnaire (what the interviewer read) is shipped. P7_1, P7_3, P7_4 agree character for character; P5's variable label is a paraphrase, the questionnaire wording is shipped. option_text is the questionnaire/value-label anchors verbatim. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3473 in Spanish only; all _translated columns were written by IRW. RESP: live set 1,2,4,5 on every item. The .do drops 8 N.S. and 9 N.C. (p5 3/11, p7_1 12/12, p7_2 2/1, p7_3 5/5, p7_4 19/6) and ALSO recodes 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' (volunteered, not read aloud; p5 34, p7_1 20, p7_2 13, p7_3 8, p7_4 18 of 2843) to missing, so no option row exists for 3 and the stored scale has a gap at 3. resp is NOT renumbered: 1 = most agreement, 5 = most disagreement. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Agreement with statements about happiness, respect for others, freedom to choose, and self-realization' matches P5 + P7_1..P7_4; no instrument mismatch. SIBLINGS: md3473/cues3473.pdf also cover spain_2024_values_political and _values (other agents this round) and institutions/difficulty (batch_323); none of their files were touched. RIGHTS: no block. Originator of the wording is CIS itself. CIS reuse-conditions page fetched 2026-09-23 (HTTP 200, sha256 3af69eae4579b53cfe1b2dd68c243026edcefbf2c0350951600782e8194755fe; not a stable hash, operative text re-read): 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales', 'La reutilización autorizada incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusión, modificación, adaptación, extracción, reordenación y combinación de la información', and 'Esta autorización conlleva, asimismo, la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual ... autorizándose la realización de actividades de reproducción, distribución, comunicación pública o transformación'. An affirmative grant; conditions are attribution ('Origen de los datos: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas'), no distortion and no implied official character, none a reserved right under irw#1945. Same conclusion as the register's CIS row (scoped in words to spain_2025_*) and the batch_323 spain_2024_values_* siblings. No register row written (a round may not write allow/ship rows).
public_note: The English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only; the volunteered middle response 'Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' (code 3, not read aloud, 8-34 respondents per item) is treated as missing by the IRW processing script, so the stored scale runs 1 (strongly agree), 2, 4, 5 (strongly disagree) with no 3

note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3473 VARIABLE LABELS /ESCIDEOL 'Escala de autoubicación ideológica (1-10)' and /PROBVOTO 'Escala de probabilidad de votar (0-10)'; VALUE LABELS ESCIDEOL 1 '1 Izquierda' 10 '10 Derecha' 98 'N.S.' 99 'N.C.' (2-9 unlabelled) and PROBVOTO 0 '0 Con toda seguridad no iría a votar' 10 '10 Con toda seguridad, iría a votar' 96 'No procede' 98 'N.S.' 99 'N.C.' (1-9 unlabelled). The questionnaire tags the two questions [ESCIDEOL] and [PROBVOTO]. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do imports 3473_num.csv with case(lower) and sets item = the variable name, so escideol/probvoto ARE the CIS names lowercased -- Step 5b exempt, no verification row or verify script. The codes are also self-describing and the two items have different scale ranges (1-10 vs 0-10), so a swap is impossible. CHECKED ANYWAY: re-running the .do logic on 3473_num.csv (id = row number; escideol 98/99 and probvoto 96/98/99 to missing; code 3 is NOT dropped for this bookmark) reproduces the live table row for row (5304 rows, identical id/item/resp; live copy from the local irw cache table_context.R filled, no new export). Live item x resp: escideol 1..10 = 257/165/321/242/716/228/261/252/63/165; probvoto 0..10 = 257/17/32/28/23/80/32/44/138/142/1841. irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE), server-side: n_rows 5304; escideol n 2670 range 1-10 with 10 levels; probvoto n 2634 range 0-10 with 11 levels. Dropped: escideol 98=44, 99=129; probvoto 96=205, 98=3, 99=1. Mean escideol 5.1, probvoto 8.3 (65% at 10), as expected for self-placement and turnout intention. PROBVOTO FILTER: the questionnaire prints 'Filtros: P.13 si P.0=1 o 2' (P.0 = nationality: 1 Spanish, 2 Spanish and other, 3 other). Code 96 'No procede' occurs exactly for the 205 respondents with P0=3 (P0=1: 0 of 2503, P0=2: 0 of 135), so probvoto was asked of Spanish nationals only. The .do's comment that 96 'is not documented in the codebook' is incorrect -- ES3473 labels it 'No procede' -- but its treatment (missing) is right, so no data defect. text_source=study_materials: item_text transcribed verbatim from cues3473.pdf P.12 and P.13 (pdftotext -layout and plain renderings agree; line breaks joined; the question numbers and bracketed variable tags not shipped). The preceding transition 'AHORA LE VAMOS A PREGUNTAR POR OTRAS CUESTIONES.' and the P.13 filter line are not shipped. Each stem already states the anchors read to the respondent, and instructions/section_prompt are blank (two standalone questions, one trivial section_id). option_text is the questionnaire's printed endpoint labels, which differ from the value labels: printed '1 Izda.' / '10 Dcha.' vs value labels '1 Izquierda' / '10 Derecha'; printed '0 No iría a votar seguro' / '10 Iría a votar seguro' vs value labels '0 Con toda seguridad no iría a votar' / '10 Con toda seguridad, iría a votar'. The questionnaire form is shipped (same rule as the batch_323 siblings), with the leading scale number stripped as it duplicates resp. Interior points (escideol 2-9, probvoto 1-9) are unlabelled in both sources and have option rows with option_text blank, never padded with their number. Option rows are item-specific: escideol has no 0; probvoto has 0. translation_source=machine_translation: all _translated text written by IRW; CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Left-right ideological self-placement and self-reported likelihood of voting' matches P.12 + P.13 exactly; no instrument mismatch. Two distinct items. RIGHTS: no block. Originator is CIS. instrument_rights_register.csv's Ben-ratified CIS 'allow' row (2026-09-22) is worded for spain_2025_*; as in batch_323 the verdict was re-derived from CIS's reuse-conditions page, fetched 2026-09-23 (HTTP 200, sha256 1303809c86ba9c7aa83816abf029bc0accb02a3c7c889fd76a5f07ebba07a1f4; page has no stable hash, operative text re-read): 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'Esta autorización conlleva, asimismo, la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual ... autorizándose la realización de actividades de reproducción, distribución, comunicación pública o transformación'. Conditions are attribution, no distortion, date of last update -- no reserved right under irw#1945. No register row written; widening the CIS row to spain_2024_* is for the orchestrator/Ben. SIBLINGS spain_2024_values_meaning and _values (other agents this round) not touched.
